verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only generic action commands, not DOM-understanding primitives that act on described elements and survive selector or layout changes. The Steel CLI offers click/fill/type (steel-docs-8), and integrations mention navigate/snapshot/extract tools. None of it says these actions resolve natural-language element descriptions rather than selectors. Element-level intelligence comes from third-party agent frameworks (Browser-Use, vision-based Computer Use) running on Steel sessions, which earns no credit as Steel's own capability.
